upstream.drop_when: The active piano-camerad path depends on this downstream SOURCE_CHANGE registration and capture-to-output negotiation, not an existing upstream protocol. Drop when the selected loopback supports equivalent NV12 size/interval enumeration and S_FMT/S_PARM handover, with acknowledgement only after buffers are released and a matching whole frame arrives; migrate the camera together and verify busy readers, timeout and producer removal. It can also be removed with a working libcamera TFE pipeline/IPA that replaces the legacy daemon, loopback and control-socket path.

Keep while the legacy camera uses the downstream loopback handshake. Its replacement must preserve OUTPUT MONOTONIC timestamps and source flags, require a fresh frame after capture STREAMON and complete negotiation through both QBUF and write. Verify repeated mmap/fork references, reader-map rejection during negotiation and no reallocation before all mappings close; remove together with the handshake if an operational native libcamera path eliminates loopback.

The selected loopback must report the negotiated virtual NV12 image through read-only CROP/CROP_DEFAULT/CROP_BOUNDS queries and retain current dimensions when TRY_FMT omits them. Verify standard clients choose the current frame rather than the minimum scaling size, without advertising physical RAW bounds or changing ordinary producers. Remove with the camera-facing loopback device when a working native libcamera path supplies these client capabilities instead.
